description: This file defines a Spring Data MongoDB repository interface for Notification entities, including a custom query method to find notifications by user ID ordered by creation date.

classes.name: NotificationRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for managing Notification entities in MongoDB, extending Spring Data's MongoRepository.

methods.name: findByUserIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc
